study.question: Can a four-state action-conditioned recurrence replacement retain direct_lifted utility and lower measured cost, after separating savings from omitting unused comparison computations? The broader frontier comparison against pooled_observed and sketch256 remains pending access to their frozen sources/receipts.
study.hypothesis: Observed: g1-r0020-direct_lifted achieved validation AUC0.6304316803980214, logloss0.19269404064402526, train676.142s, inference25.0225s,17253123 allocated parameters, and wall788.542s at seed42. The available static/pooled/DIN references achieved AUC0.605004/0.610226/0.613362, respectively; these are different architectures, not single-factor evidence. Source inspection shows the frozen forward computes discarded exchangeable transition statistics, unlabeled repeat/overlap replacements, and the chronological support separately for gap and transition. Thus omitting those computations may reduce cost while preserving selected features. Provisional representation hypothesis: target-match partitioning inside the transition branch is partly redundant with the retained target-aware pooled, identity, context, repeat and overlap branches, so action-only transition counts may retain utility. This is untested; target relevance in other branches does not establish redundancy in this branch. The frozen gap representation already pools target/action states, but that fact does not prove transfer to transitions.

nearest_work.difference: Closest local implementation. Inherit its entire parameterization and all non-transition inputs. One control computes only selected alternatives; the candidate coarsens transition states before counts/product, with a fixed balanced state-map replacement control. No claimed novelty for pooling, count summaries, factorization or isometric lifts.

nearest_work.difference: DIN learns ad-conditioned event weights with an unnormalized weighted sum in its paper. This proposal keeps the local inherited deterministic target groups and tests a fixed coarse transition count summary; it introduces no learned attention mechanism. The local baseline_reference.py uses a field-adapted softmax attention and is not an exact DIN reproduction. No detailed author-code reproduction claim is made.

The author README warns the dataset histories have category, brand and behavior type but no item. The replacement respects that boundary and does not invent item IDs. The full publisher paper was not available in the authorized archive, so no detailed DMR mechanism comparison or priority claim is verified.

inherited_components: Exact frozen model source and all initialization draws, including dormant attention allocation
Static field embeddings, true target-match pooling, counts, action/age histogram, independent moments and global field norms
Joint identity and context entropy/collision summaries, conditional repeat summaries and overlap Gram readout
Singleton timestamp support on complete category/brand events; exclude every tied timestamp member and bridge excluded events only on the supported subsequence
Chronological recurrence counts, empirical C*B/N replacement, fixed gap bins, pooled observed gap counts and lifted4096 gap parameterization
Frozen host data, labels, scorer, sample coverage, scratch training, seeds and validation timing scope
study.proposed_difference: Three selected-execution modules inherit the frozen source, retain every trainable module, and override forward plus candidate diagnostics. They omit unused repeat product/unlabeled tables, overlap product/unlabeled tables, exchangeable temporal alternatives and actual pair-equality counts discarded by the product readout; gap/transition share one chronological support. The selected_exact control keeps the full1024 transition representation. The action_pooled candidate maps events to their four action states, obtains64 transition coordinates, then replicates each scalar into the old target-group axes with scale1/4 after log1p. The rotated_pooled control uses (action_index+match_group) modulo4 with the identical lift. The lifted gap head and all pre-transition features remain exactly inherited. No new parameters, optimizer, loss or data are introduced. Equal allocated capacity does not imply equal effective statistical capacity. These are local replacement hypotheses; novelty relative to all prior methods remains unverified.
predictions: Before interpreting utility, selected_exact must match the frozen model at the same checkpoint: repeat/overlap/transition selected feature max errors<=2e-6, shared gap raw count error0, and total logit max error<=2e-5. All variants must have finite logits; independent quadratic chronological-count oracle, edge conservation, reordering, padding, empty, missing-brand, tied-time and zero-length checks must pass (raw count tolerances1e-6). Lift norm squared error<=1e-4; diagnostics are candidate-supplied, restricted to first8 rows for quadratic probes, and never proof of utility or timing.

Predeclared utility retention: paired candidate-minus-frozen AUC must be>=-0.001 absolute and logloss increase<=0.0002. Seed42 screening thresholds using the imported reference are AUC>=0.6294316803980214 and logloss<=0.19289404064402526; the current rerun is the paired comparator. Final validation-only retention requires the margins in every completed paired seed42,43,44, with mean/range reported. If supported paired user-cluster bootstrap is available, report intervals without treating impressions as independent; otherwise no significance claim or formal noninferiority claim.

A useful measured total efficiency result requires at least10% lower median host training time or inference time than frozen_direct over completed paired repetitions, no>5% regression in the other timing view, and retained utility. Report wall time, allocated GPU seconds when host supplies them, examples processed, allocated parameters, peak memory, throughput and batch4096 p50/p95 latencies including causal gathering. No parameter reduction is predicted: all variants allocate17253123 parameters. Repeated measurements must use the same device, coverage, batch size, host warmup/synchronization protocol and full-population validation. Do not time inside model forward or diagnostics.

Separate the execution effect (selected_exact versus frozen_direct) from the representation effect (action_pooled versus selected_exact). Claim an incremental representation cost benefit only with>=3% median training or inference reduction relative to selected_exact, utility retention, and a consistent direction across repetitions. If only selected_exact is faster, attribute total savings to selected execution rather than the coarse representation.

Action pooling is target-invariant only within the replaced transition branch; earlier branches remain target-aware. A retained-utility advantage over the equal-width rotated control would be provisional evidence for action-aligned grouping. Similar outcomes preserve generic bottleneck, occupancy, regularization and optimizer explanations.

Report predefined host slices including empty/short/long histories, hour, behavior presence and training-frequency groups with their supplied counts. Any additional slice is exploratory, and slices with insufficient class support are marked insufficient. A full-population result cannot establish benefit for empty or rare-action histories.

Preserve the allowed static/pooled/DIN and direct_lifted trajectories, including their utility/cost tradeoffs. Search for lifted/sketch/cost returned no scoped agent-memory records; trial://g1-r0019-pooled_observed failed as an unknown authorized reference. Neither pooled_observed nor sketch256 has an accessible frozen source/receipt in this context. Do not synthesize scores or reconstruct a control under the frozen name; the requested frontier comparison to them cannot be established here. No negative or abandoned experimental trajectory beyond the supplied index is observable, so historical mechanism support remains incomplete.
falsifiers: A host feature/oracle/integrity failure invalidates the implementation comparison; it is distinct from scientific counterevidence and from unavailable inputs. Retain failed attempt costs and repair source only within the frozen contract.
AUC loss beyond0.001 or logloss increase beyond0.0002 on paired validation falsifies utility retention for that implementation/seed; inconsistent repetitions leave retention unsupported.

No reproducible>=10% cost reduction versus frozen_direct, or>5% worsening in the other timing view, falsifies the proposed total efficiency benefit at the declared operating point. A speed benefit solely in selected_exact does not establish a representation mechanism.
No incremental>=3% cost improvement versus selected_exact leaves the representation-specific efficiency claim unsupported even if utility is retained.
Equivalent action and rotated grouping results weaken the semantic grouping explanation; action pooling failure does not refute all possible simpler replacements.

Missing authorized pooled_observed/sketch256 evidence prevents the broader frontier claim; it is not a measured failure or success. No holdout scores or predictions may be requested or used in this operational rerun.
alternative_explanations: Noise from one seed, early checkpoint selection, device load, timing granularity or memory allocation; paired repetitions and repeated host timings are required.
The inherited deep stack, gap branch or static embeddings may dominate utility; one retained-utility replacement does not identify which branch carries the signal.
Removing target groups and changing product resolution are coupled here; differences cannot attribute solely to loss of target labels.

Isometric replication preserves norm and allocated capacity but changes effective rank, gradient correlations and effective Adam dynamics. The rotated control matches this geometry but changes occupancy/semantics; a later compact/update-calibrated control may be needed.
The coarse transition input may act as regularization rather than preserve the same recurrence mechanism. Neither lower count-table size nor source equivalence guarantees end-to-end speed.
Most parameters are inherited embeddings, and the unchanged lifted gap/transition heads remain costly; the frozen host feature gathering can dominate inference and limit savings.
Publisher static snapshots have undocumented as-of dates; the frozen benchmark assumption is not verified production point-in-time validity.
External source results involve different fields, tasks and splits. Archived sources verify provenance only, with no automatic local transfer; broad novelty is unverified.

cost_plan.attribution_reserve: Four initial full-protocol seed42 runs: frozen_direct, selected_exact, action_pooled, rotated_pooled. Worst-case4*1760.932=7043.730s, typical4*788.542=3154.170s, with no subset screening or optimizer changes. Reserve the rotated replacement as a real measured control. If feature diagnostics fail, charge the attempt and spend a repair trial only if the assessment reserve remains intact. No automatic duplicate when execution state is unknown.
cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Validation-only final suite provisionally contains action_pooled, selected_exact, frozen_direct at paired seeds42,43,44. Initial seed42 runs count toward that suite if source/config/protocol hashes match. Reserve six additional full units for seeds43/44:6*1760.932=10565.595s; total initial+reserve17609.324s, leaving2667.051s from the entry budget for preparation/diagnostics/timing/failures. Typical cost is much lower, but do not spend the worst-case reserve on broad search. Repeat rotated_pooled on43/44 only if the actual remaining ledger accommodates both units and its contrast remains consequential. If valid final selection changes, explicitly freeze the source/config/checkpoint hashes, comparison suite, seeds and commands before assessment; never consume closed assessment data. For each module host reproduction is Model(meta, registered variant config) from scratch with the frozen training recipe. This proposal phase has no checkpoints or new measured model results.
cost_plan.stop_rule: Check the authoritative ledger before each host execution. Stop search before a run would consume the reserved six final units plus required preparation/assessment overhead, or on the hard time limit, user stop, unresolved integrity failure, or no useful admissible experiment. Do not increase any cap. If preparation or failure costs exceed the2667.051s envelope, reduce the number of subsequent repeats before launching them, retain completed receipts, and label resulting seed evidence preliminary. Do not silently resubmit unknown-state runs. Freeze and report null/negative findings as faithfully as improvements. Future falsifiable question: if action coarsening retains utility but adds no cost gain beyond execution pruning, can an update-calibrated compact64-input transition head reduce cost without changing utility?
